The line finder classes some border pieces as large components, makes others into lines of their own (lines 1, 2, 4, 10, 16, 24, 28 and 29), and attaches others to text lines 9, 14, 15, 17-20, 23 and 26. All of these are left unlabeled: whole lines by a null rule and attached pieces by split rules. Only the rule above the notes and thin horizontal large components are labeled separator.
